permissions.galleryText: Gallery permission is required to add items and enable the item duplication detection feature. Please allow access to continue.
permissions.cameraText: Camera permission is required to add items and enable the item duplication detection feature. Please allow access to continue.

register.title: Add an item
register.intro: Coffer checks the photo against your collection, so duplicates are counted instead of added twice.
register.step2: Take a photo or pick one from the gallery
register.chooseFirst: Choose a collection first to continue.
register.checkFailed: The image couldn’t be checked. Please try again.
register.noneFoundHint: Take a closer photo of the item in good light.
register.endText: Tap Finish when you are done. To change something, go back to a page with the arrows.
register.legendUpload: Pages with a check will be saved.
register.legendSkip: Pages with a cross are skipped.
register.chooseMatch: Add as new, or choose a match
register.helpNew: The item looks new, so by default it is added as a new entry. If that’s wrong, choose one of the three closest matches to add the detected quantity to it.
register.helpFound: The item looks like one you already have, so by default the detected quantity is added to the closest match. If that’s wrong, choose another match or add it as a new item.
register.zeroQuantity: Setting the quantity to 0 removes the item from the list.

details.privateNoteHelp: Only you can see the private note. Use it for extra information, e.g. where the item is in your physical collection.
details.descriptionHelp: The description is public, like a post about the item.

edit.title: Edit item
edit.minQuantity: At least 1 piece is required. To remove the item, use Delete.

delete.title: Delete item?
delete.message: This {{type}} will be removed from your collection. This can’t be undone.
